---
title: "Class 7. Joins, pivots and the Rosling chart (solutions)"
format: html
---

Teacher version. It needs `data/gapminder_regions.csv` from class 6.

```{r}
#| label: setup
pacman::p_load(here, tidyverse, nycflights13, gganimate, gifski)
```

## 1. Joins: the key has the same name

```{r}
#| label: join-airlines
flights |>
  left_join(airlines, by = "carrier") |>
  count(name) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
```

## 2. Joins: rows without a match

```{r}
#| label: anti-planes
flights |>
  anti_join(planes, by = "tailnum") |>
  count(carrier)
```

## 3. Joins: the key has two names

```{r}
#| label: join-airports
flights |>
  left_join(airports, by = join_by(origin == faa)) |>
  count(name)
```

## 4. Join a summary back to the table

```{r}
#| label: gap
here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  left_join(
    here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv") |>
      read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
      filter(year == 2007) |>
      group_by(continent) |>
      summarize(continent_life = mean(life_exp)),
    by = "continent"
  ) |>
  mutate(gap = life_exp - continent_life) |>
  select(country, continent, life_exp, continent_life, gap) |>
  arrange(desc(gap)) |>
  head(5)
```

## 5. Pivot wider

```{r}
#| label: wider
here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year %in% c(1952, 1982, 2007)) |>
  group_by(continent, year) |>
  summarize(median_income = median(income), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = median_income) |>
  mutate(ratio = `2007` / `1952`)
```

## 6. Pivot longer and plot

```{r}
#| label: longer
here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year %in% c(1952, 1982, 2007)) |>
  group_by(continent, year) |>
  summarize(median_income = median(income), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = median_income) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -continent,
    names_to = "year",
    values_to = "median_income",
    names_transform = as.integer
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = median_income, color = continent)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1)
```

## 7. The Rosling chart for 1982

```{r}
#| label: rosling-1982
here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year == 1982) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = income, y = life_exp, size = population, color = subregion)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 15) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 8. Panels for two years

```{r}
#| label: facets
here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(year %in% c(1952, 2007)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = income, y = life_exp, size = population, color = continent)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 12) +
  facet_wrap(~ year) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 9. Animate Europe

```{r}
#| label: animate-europe
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
here("data", "gapminder_regions.csv") |>
  read_csv(show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(continent == "Europe") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = income, y = life_exp, size = population, color = subregion)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 15) +
  labs(title = "Year: {round(frame_time)}") +
  theme_minimal() +
  transition_time(year)
```
